authority.lhit_role: stripped donor invariants re-derived into long-horizon training episodes
authority.scientific_claim_ceiling: NO CFE CAUSAL CLAIM FROM THIS CORPUS

cfe_informed_invariants.name: BROAD_IDENTIFYING_SUPPORT
cfe_informed_invariants.operationalization: prefer examples/episode sets that expose enough neighboring cases to distinguish the intended rule from plausible rivals; avoid narrow repetitive slices

cfe_informed_invariants.name: USEFUL_CONTRAST
cfe_informed_invariants.operationalization: select nearby positive/negative, isomorphic/anti-isomorphic, correct/repair, and changed-condition examples where the distinction is learner-visible

cfe_informed_invariants.name: STRUCTURED_REVISIT
cfe_informed_invariants.operationalization: revisit related skills after spacing and under changed surface form rather than exhausting one source/skill block at once

cfe_informed_invariants.name: CURRENTNESS_AND_REVISION
cfe_informed_invariants.operationalization: include episodes where earlier state becomes stale after a dependency/evidence change and the later answer must update rather than repeat

cfe_informed_invariants.name: CONSEQUENTIAL_HISTORY
cfe_informed_invariants.operationalization: preserve prior turns/events only when they alter later obligations, answers, tool choices, state, or confidence

cfe_informed_invariants.name: UNKNOWN_PRESERVATION
cfe_informed_invariants.operationalization: retain examples whose correct outcome is insufficient evidence / unresolved rather than forcing a guessed completion

cfe_informed_invariants.name: COMPOSITION_PRESSURE
cfe_informed_invariants.operationalization: include tasks that require composing already-supported primitives, while separately tagging composition so primitive competence is not mistaken for composition competence

cfe_informed_invariants.name: NEGATIVE_SPACE_COVERAGE
cfe_informed_invariants.operationalization: track capability/domain/behavior holes and source overconcentration; choose new atoms by uncertainty/coverage value rather than popularity alone

lhit_stripped_invariants.name: LONG_HORIZON_STATE_CARRY
lhit_stripped_invariants.qualifier: later turns must actually depend on earlier state; raw conversation length does not qualify

lhit_stripped_invariants.name: FOLLOWUP_CONSEQUENCE_TRACKING
lhit_stripped_invariants.qualifier: later observations/results must change what should be concluded or done

lhit_stripped_invariants.name: REVISIT_AFTER_CHANGE
lhit_stripped_invariants.qualifier: an earlier belief/plan/authorization is explicitly re-evaluated after new evidence or changed conditions

lhit_stripped_invariants.name: CONTRADICTION_RECOVERY
lhit_stripped_invariants.qualifier: the episode contains an actual conflict and a grounded correction path

lhit_stripped_invariants.name: UNRESOLVED_SEAM_RETENTION
lhit_stripped_invariants.qualifier: unknowns persist across turns until relevant evidence resolves them

lhit_stripped_invariants.name: QUESTION_RETENTION
lhit_stripped_invariants.qualifier: the trajectory resists locally plausible topic drift and returns decisions to the governing objective

lhit_stripped_invariants.name: FAILED_BRANCH_RECOVERY
lhit_stripped_invariants.qualifier: a mistaken or unproductive branch is recognized and corrected without discarding valid accumulated state

lhit_stripped_invariants.name: EVIDENCE_STATE_SEPARATION
lhit_stripped_invariants.qualifier: remembered state, direct observation, inference and uncertainty remain distinguishable

lhit_stripped_invariants.name: MULTITURN_CAPABILITY_GROWTH
lhit_stripped_invariants.qualifier: later performance uses consequences/structures earned earlier in the same episode rather than treating every turn as a fresh isolated prompt

minimum: later-state dependency or explicit capability value
synthetic_lhit: generated episode cannot copy evaluation-only probes
objective facts independently checked where checkable
state transitions and consequence dependencies machine-validated where possible
failed candidates preserved with rejection reason

ordering.goal: one best standard practical ordering, not treatment/control arms
rules: balance by target tokens and capability coverage rather than row count
keep causally dependent multi-turn episodes intact
use contrast neighborhoods where learner-visible distinctions are meaningful
do not over-cluster synthetic teacher style
preserve a broad support basis before difficult composition-heavy tails
